remarks: Wanting the complete package & can't find at an affordable price, look no further...WASHER/DRYER in unit, updated kitchen w/ DISHWASHER, A/C, GARAGE PARKING, rooftop deck, all within walking distance to DOWNTOWN, train, restaurants, BARS, parks, shopping, TARGET, everything right outside your doorstep. Fully renovated mint condition in ideal downtown, walkable location. Stunning open floor plan w/ granite kitchen, breakfast bar that opens to large living room w/ dining area, updated bath, and massive bedroom with TWO HUGE closets. Separate LAUNDRY in unit w/ additional storage space. Corner unit with lots of windows and light, great views. 1 car garage parking along with additional outside parking and guest parking. NO ADDITIONAL MONTHLY COST for amenities, parking, trash, water, sewer, that's all included in the rent! Steps away from beautifully renovated Mill River Park and all it has to offer. Roof top deck offer amazing space to relax, have dinner, or morning coffee, offers beautiful views of downtown and Long Island Sound. A true gem, not to be missed
